availableButInsufficient.gap: Coordinate caching alone does not enforce the complete version/time/order/duplicate-tag/canonical-byte/counter/independent-audit contract. SimpleHandler locations=True calls ignore_errors; it cannot be substituted silently.
Filtering can avoid Python objects but drops the evidence needed to validate discarded source metadata unless a native validating handler runs first.
Python callbacks retain per-node Python work; installed BufferIterator stub exposes no Python buffer-construction API for a new bulk validator.

selectedArchitecture.core: New C++17 PBF-only validation/index shared library behind a small C ABI, loaded via ctypes in the existing qualified Python worker; no C++ object or CPython extension ABI crossing.
selectedArchitecture.build: Separate digest-pinned linux/arm64 manylinux_2_28 builder; no alteration of cached runtime/site. Static libstdc++/libgcc if supported; only audited runtime dependencies, with real cached-runtime loader and fixture checks required.
selectedArchitecture.pythonEvents: Selected complete raw records, canonical-size boundary fallback, and bounded binary batches for hashlib/checksums/checkpoints; no ordinary per-node Python objects or canonical JSON.
selectedArchitecture.metadataSeal: Length-prefixed lossless binary projected-field tuples, with sorted UTF-8 tag keys, ordered refs/members, exact integer XY/time/ID/version/visibility. Python hashlib hashes bounded byte batches. This seal differs from full-stream canonical JSON hashes; prove its decoded fields equivalent and keep emitted selected canonical JSON identical.
selectedArchitecture.independentAudit: Preserve the two-pass proposal: primary selection on pass one; pass two independently rebuilds coordinate blocks/selection/membership and materializes raw objects. Primary IDs are hints only; independent exact key/output/geometry reconciliation rejects omissions/extras. No primary index reuse.
selectedArchitecture.status: Design only; core, ABI compatibility and native guard equivalence unimplemented/unqualified.
